description_for_human: Retrieves grounding content from a Foundry IQ knowledge base in Azure AI Search
description_for_model: Performs agentic retrieval against a Foundry IQ knowledge base hosted in Azure AI Search. Use this plugin to look up curated domain, product, or reference knowledge. Pass the user's question as a clear standalone query in the text field of the first user message.

functions.name: retrieveFoundryKnowledge
functions.description: Retrieves relevant passages and source references from the Foundry IQ knowledge base for a natural language question. Returns extracted content the model should use as grounding to answer, along with references to the source documents.
